title: Beside the Trailer
hook: A rig sits level with your door.
scene: A rig comes up on your left and sits there, level with your door. You can't find the driver's face in either mirror.
decision: You can't find his face in either mirror. What do you do?

options.text: Hold your speed and stay alongside
options.result: You hold the door. He still cannot see you in either mirror. The trailer walks with you. If he needs your lane he will take it. You stayed in the blind spot.

options.text: Ease off and let it get clear
options.result: You lift. The rig walks forward until both door mirrors can own a Beetle. You can find his face again. You let it pass. Cheaper on every axis than holding or punching it.

options.text: Accelerate to clear the front of it
options.result: You stay in the blind spot longer, only faster. The Beetle walks rough in his spray. If he drifts you meet the trailer at speed. Ease off was the cheaper clear.

debrief: Stay out of a large truck's blind spots. If you can't see the driver's mirrors, the driver can't see you — ease off and let it pass.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one
source.teaching_target: Stay out of a large truck's blind spots. If you can't see the driver's mirrors, ease off and let it pass.
